vulnerability_analysis: The BossBaby contract has a tradingEnabled flag that restricts token transfers for non-excluded addresses. Initially false, only the owner can enable trading via enableTrading(). The exploit requires becoming the owner (or impersonating them) to call this function.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the current owner using vm.prank() and call enableTrading() to set tradingEnabled to true.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address from the contract. 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 3. Call enableTrading() on the target contract. 4. Verify tradingEnabled is now true.
